name: 79-vendor-effect-aliases
css: body { margin: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.5; color: #111; background: #fff; } .page { padding: 10px; } p { margin: 4px 0; } .box { width: 150px; height: 42px; margin-bottom: 22px; padding: 6px; color: #fff; background: #1f6f78; } .std-last { -webkit-transform: translateX(24px); transform: translateX(8px); } .prefix-last { transform: translateX(8px); -webkit-transform: translateX(24px); } .filter-std-last { -webkit-filter: grayscale(1); filter: brightness(1); } .filter-prefix-last { filter: brightness(1); -webkit-filter: grayscale(1); } .origin { -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; transform: rotate(8deg); }
html:
